intro: Cold Stone Creamery is the ice cream chain where mix-ins are folded into your ice cream on a frozen granite stone. Sizes are called Like It (about 5 oz), Love It (about 8 oz) and Gotta Have It (about 12 oz), and the menu covers Signature Creations, Create Your Own, shakes, smoothies and ice cream cakes. Below are Cold Stone prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Cold Stone Creamery, a Signature Creation costs about $5.00 to $6.29 for a Like It, $5.25 to $7.08 for a Love It and $5.75 to $8.25 for a Gotta Have It. Create Your Own starts at about $4.00 with the first mix-in free; extra mix-ins are about $0.75 to $0.90. Shakes are about $5.00 to $5.75, and ice cream cakes start around $24. Prices vary by store.
